panelIntro: Hold something up to the camera. The bars show how sure the computer is about each class.
notTrained: Train the model first, then come back here.
noCamera: Turn on the camera above to try it live, or freeze a photo you uploaded.

confidence.heading: How sure it is
confidence.sumNote: These always add up to 100%. The computer never says "I don't know" — it always picks the closest class it was given, even for something it has never seen.

freeze.hint: Freeze a frame to look at why it decided that.

close: It is close between {{first}} and {{second}}. When two are nearly level, the model is not really distinguishing them.
